issues.summary: [Teams Core 1.0.25] installed, desktop, and mobile UI evidence is missing
issues.description: Command, package, portal, and public-runtime gates passed for app version 1.0.25. The required same-release installed-client version check, desktop screenshot/AX evidence, and mobile confirmation are not yet captured. The current UI matrix has 149 rows: PASS=0, FAIL=0, BLOCKED=148, N/A=1. Reproduce by reusing the existing Teams desktop and mobile app surfaces, then capture before/after screenshots, accessibility evidence, and runtime evidence for each exercised branch. Do not close from CLI, portal, or HTTP evidence alone.
issues.acceptance: The installed app visibly reports version 1.0.25, the desktop chat/tab and every exercised branch have fresh before/after screenshots plus AX/runtime evidence, and the mobile Teams user confirms the same release behavior. Then update this issue with evidence paths and transition it using a workflow transition discovered from Jira.

issues.summary: [Teams Core] reconcile Teams CLI SSO doctor diagnostics with live bot+tab contract
issues.description: The Teams CLI doctor reports one SSO failure and warnings for the resource URI and valid-domain pattern, while the official bot+tab SSO guidance and the portal read-back show the combined resource URI and exact token.botframework.com domain. This is a diagnostic discrepancy, not a confirmed runtime defect. Compare the doctor implementation/version with the official contract and close only after a live SSO failure is reproduced or the diagnostic is verified as stale.
issues.acceptance: A fresh Teams SSO runtime check either reproduces a token exchange failure with sanitized evidence and a follow-up Bug, or documents the doctor discrepancy as non-actionable with the official contract and successful runtime evidence.
